title: Engine becomes unresponsive and crashes after attempting to close running preview (possibly driver related)
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested both 4.4.1 and 4.3, mono and regular version

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono, linux 6.16.4-arch1-1 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 GRE (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

After attempting to shut down the game preview window, the entire application becomes unresponsive and turns black, occasionally crashing but most often needing to be manually shut down by killing the process in order to fully close.

The following is the output of the program from the start of the game preview:

```

ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: FAILED
   at: command_queue_execute_and_present (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:2655)
```

After crashing/killing the process, the project file appears corrupted, with any non-default configuration being reverted (notably, the project name and all custom input mappings)

Forcing the opengl3 driver prevents the issue from happening, so this is clearly an issue with vulkan. Moreover, this same issue happens in earlier versions, and I began experiencing it after updating my system, which included a driver update. This could be the source of the issue.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open up a godot project
- Run it
- Close the running game window

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Seemingly any project will present the issue
